sloka: इमे शूराः समर्थाश्च सर्वतो हरियूथपाः ।त्वत्प्रियार्थम् कृतोत्साहाः प्रवेष्टुमपि पावकम् ॥६-२-७॥।।
transliteration: ime śūrāḥ samarthāśca sarvato hariyūthapāḥ ।tvatpriyārtham kṛtotsāhāḥ praveṣṭumapi pāvakam ॥6-2-7॥।।

translations.english: All these vanara leaders and heroes are highly capable and for your happiness they are even ready to enter fire. I know this from their joy and I even infer that it is certain (to happen).
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌! वह लङ्का जिस प्रकार परकोटे, खाइयों तथा राक्षस सेना से रक्षित है, वह सब में कहता हूँ, सुनिए
